notices.title: End-semester exam timetable published
notices.body: The end-semester exams run from 14 to 23 December 2026. The full dates are on the Fees and exams page. Hall tickets are given out from 7 December.

notices.title: Tuition installment 2 is due on 30 November
notices.body: Pay at the accounts window or online. A late fee applies for each day after the due date. Scholarship students should check the amount for their category.

notices.title: Project review week for Year 3
notices.body: Reviews for the software engineering projects run from 23 to 27 November. Teams get their slot by email from the project coordinator.

notices.title: Tech talk: how a database reads your query
notices.body: A guest talk on query plans, on 20 November at 15:00 in the seminar hall. All years can attend. Year 2 section B has one class moved to 14:00 that day, so it does not clash.

notices.title: Resume workshop for Year 3
notices.body: A hands-on session on writing a one-page resume, on 24 November at 16:00 in room C-301. Bring a printed draft.

notices.title: Hall tickets: collect from the department office
notices.body: Hall tickets are given out from 7 December. Bring your student ID. The exam fee must be paid first.

notices.title: Lab practical exams start on 25 November
notices.body: Data Structures Lab (Year 2) is on 25 November and Database Lab (Year 3) is on 26 November. Carry your lab record.

notices.title: Scholarship students: renew your income certificate
notices.body: Submit the renewed certificate to the department office by 28 November, or the installment waiver will not be applied.

notices.title: Department club hack night on 6 December
notices.body: An overnight build session in the labs, from 18:00 on 6 December. Teams of up to four. Sign up with the club coordinators.

notices.title: Attendance shortage list is on the notice board
notices.body: Students below 75 percent attendance can submit a condonation form with a reason by 24 November.

notices.title: Department office closed on 27 November
notices.body: The office is closed for the whole day for maintenance. Submit anything due that week by 26 November.

notices.title: Mid-term revaluation window closes on 21 November
notices.body: Apply for revaluation at the office with the fee receipt. Late forms are not taken.
